topBuffs.localizedDesc: At the start of the fight, a {2} second timer starts. If this timer expires, the fight results in a time out. The timer is paused during the Attacker’s first 3 Special Attacks 1 or 2, and it is always paused during Special Attack 3.

The following [k=glossary/game_rule]Rules of The Contest[/k] are active:
 • The Defender's damage taken is adjusted based on the difference between the Attacker and Defender's [k=glossary/challenge_rating]Challenge Ratings[/k].
 • The Defender cannot activate their Special Attack 3.
 • Both Champion's Attack Rating does not decrease with Class Disadvantage.
